summary_md: **Ricardo Pinho ([@rpinho_sci](https://x.com/rpinho_sci/status/2116262684756734429))** reports his agents filed three unrefereed bounds to the optimization constants table (C44 ≤ 4.1225324, C86 ≤ 1.80697883, C68 ≥ 0.44667) as open PRs, building on prior lemmas and polynomials ([teorth/optimizationproblems PRs](https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems/pulls/rpinho)).
